snippet.title: Drown in cards in Critterrupters - Monster Taming Direct
snippet.description:
Critterbyte Chips may be the newest craze but the Critterbyte TCG is still going strong. As you're exploring the island and battling with other trainers, you can collect and swap cards with them too. 
And of course the booster pack ripping returns!

Wishlist today on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3448130?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=cards
